objective: Compare the source-equation behavior of registered Add Noise CPU, dedicated GPU wrapper HLSL, and resident generic HLSL routes on matched synthetic BGRA float images, focusing on seed conversion, RGB response/clamping, alpha, size blocks, and selected route parity.

scope.effect: Artifact::AddNoiseEffect, stable ID add_noise, GPU generic key add_noise
routes: Dedicated GPU wrapper AddNoiseEffectGPUImpl::applyGPU shader equation
Resident generic shader registered by appendGpuSpatialNodes
scope.method: Independent Python/NumPy source-equation mirrors. No C++ implementation, app, GPU, or test executable is run.

comparison.baseline: Synthetic input float surface with noise amount=0; report both in-range and HDR values to reveal whether neutral processing clamps RGB.
candidates: Seed 0, 73, 1977 at amount=.4, size=1.5, color mode.
Color, monochrome, and luminance-only modes at seed 73, amount=.4, size=1.5.
Size .5, 1, 1.5, 3 at seed 73, amount=.4, color mode.
Amount .1 and .4 at seed 73, size=1.5, color mode.
Resident size parameter multipliers .25, .5, 1.0 and shader denominator floor .1 are reported as parameter mapping only, not rendered LOD images.
comparison.ground_truth: None. The input is a deterministic synthetic diagnostic plate, not an approved image target.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive equation audit only. Route equality is reported as numeric equation agreement, not compiled/runtime parity. No aesthetic pass/fail threshold.

materials.fixtures: Script-generated 512x256 and 1024x512 BGRA float plate with black/mid/high/HDR ramps, transparent/half-alpha/opaque regions, narrow lines and checker detail.
materials.rights: Synthetic diagnostic generated by the study script.
materials.identity: SHA-256 of source files, plan, script, and emitted source/route PNG previews recorded in metrics. Fixed seeds and deterministic equations.

conditions.seed: 0, 73, and 1977; dedicated HLSL mirror uses float32 seed bit-pattern asuint semantics, while CPU/resident mirrors use numeric uint32 conversion.
conditions.color_and_alpha: Canonical CPU storage is BGRA float32. Metrics use RGB channels reordered to logical RGB and source alpha separately. No transfer conversion or compositing in raw metrics; previews composite over gray and white.
conditions.output: Float32 route arrays for metrics; 16-bit PNG inspection plates and 8-bit contact sheets only for visual review.
metrics: whole, HDR, alpha-edge, flat, and detail ROIs

effect_correctness.method: Verify floor(coord/size), hash/channel selection, seed conversion, mode precedence, per-channel clamp, and alpha preservation against source markers.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Deterministic output and explicit route-equation differences; no compiled parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect full input/route plates and fixed flat, fine-detail, and block-size regions at native and enlarged display sizes.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic gate; report block structure, clipping, channel tint, and fine-line response.

color_and_alpha.method: Report logical RGB and alpha separately, with transparent/half-alpha/opaque ROIs and HDR/highlight values.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Production alpha association, transfer function, downstream blend, and export behavior.

temporal_stability.method: A fixed seed has no frame input in these equations; report that fact and do not infer temporal quality.
temporal_stability.unverified: Actual frame/seed automation outside this effect and rendered sequence behavior.

render_paths_and_resolution.method: Model CPU, dedicated wrapper, and resident equations at two image dimensions; list resident LOD size multipliers from source.
render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Actual route selection, GPU/backend parity, and interactive preview output.

performance.reason: No product timing or allocation profiling.

execution.backend: Python 3, NumPy source-equation mirror; no external assets or network.
execution.threshold_policy: No image-quality threshold. Numeric route differences are descriptive.
execution.reproducibility: Record source/plan/script hashes, library versions, generated fixture hashes, route parameters, and metrics checksum.
